state.claim: The proposed index reduced query latency.
state.evidence: Median latency dropped from 43 ms to 18 ms with the proposed index on the held-out workload.

state.claim: The model was more accurate than the comparator.
state.evidence: Accuracy was 87.1% for the model and 89.4% for the comparator.
The study measured symptom severity but did not report mortality outcomes.
